ratingNote: Owner-confirmed 2026-09-02 by reading the live App Store: 4.2 / 25 ratings (report of 2026-09-01 read 4.24 / 25; JSON-LD carries one decimal). Previous 4.4 / 22 was owner-reported 2026-08-12. NOT machine-verified from the agent sandbox (CONNECT to itunes.apple.com is refused by the egress proxy, re-confirmed 2026-09-02); seo-daily.yml runs check-store-facts.mjs --net daily and reports drift in the job summary. Re-check: curl -s "https://itunes.apple.com/lookup?id=6758438948&country=jp" | grep -o '"userRatingCount":[0-9]*' — then edit ratingValue/ratingCount here and run node scripts/sync_constants.js --write.
appVersionNote: PUBLIC App Store version. Owner-confirmed 2026-09-05 by reading the live App Store: v5.8.17. This supersedes the 2026-09-02 reading of 5.8.4. **Notion Inbox shipped in 5.8.12**, so the public build now carries it (relay /v1/notion/config returned {"available":true} from 2026-09-04 14:31Z). Keep this as the RELEASED version, not simplememo-ios/project.pbxproj's MARKETING_VERSION: release.yml ships tag -> Xcode Cloud -> TestFlight and App Review submission is a separate opt-in step (submit_review defaults to false), so the two legitimately diverge. Re-check with: curl -s 'https://itunes.apple.com/lookup?id=6758438948&country=jp' | grep -o '"version":"[^"]*"' — then edit this one field and run: node scripts/sync_constants.js --write to propagate to the JSON-LD blocks and llms.txt. **A Claude Code sandbox cannot run that curl** (the egress proxy answers CONNECT with 403; measured 5 times on 09-04/09-05). seo-daily.yml runs check-store-facts.mjs --net on a runner that CAN reach Apple, but that step has neither --write nor `tee`, so its answer lands only in the run's step summary and is readable by neither the ledger nor the job log. Until that is changed, this field moves only when a human reads the store.

priceNote: Confirmed unchanged by the owner on 2026-08-22. Values were set 2026-06-11 (PR #342) and have not been changed since — the owner states the prices are still current. **Still not machine-verified against App Store Connect**: IAP prices are not returned by the iTunes Lookup API, and the ASC API needs credentials this sandbox does not have. Prices appear on the site (pricing sections and JSON-LD offers), so a stale value would be a consumer-protection risk, not just a docs bug: Apple periodically adjusts JPY price tiers for FX. If that ever happens, update these four fields and this note's date, then run node scripts/sync_constants.js --write. Checked by scripts/check-store-facts.mjs (180-day window; longer than ratings because prices rarely change, but not unbounded).
